body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Covington Creations officially launched 'Earbud Yo-Yo' during CES 2009, which is a cable organizing device invented by Julie Johnson Barkley. It is designed to organize the earbuds supplied with MP3 Players, iPods and cellular telephones equipped with MP3 Players.
